title: KM KS-AUV Vertical Straight Knife Cutter
subtitle: Reciprocating Blade Cutting System with Automatic Sharpening
overviewDescription: The KM KS-AUV is a Japan-made vertical reciprocating straight knife fabric cutting machine manufactured by KM Cloth Cutting Machine Co., Ltd. It is the industry standard for high-volume textile cutting, featuring a high-torque motor, automatic abrasive belt sharpening, and a centralized lubrication system.

classificationTable.value: KM Cloth Cutting Machine Co., Ltd. (Japan)
Knit, Synthetic Fiber, Denim, Vinyl, Leather

technicalSpecs.value: High Speed Steel (Straight or Wave types)

workingPrinciples.heading: 1. Mechanical Drive
workingPrinciples.description: The motor drives a rotor shaft (M-004) which is connected to a crank (M-027). A connecting rod (M-036) links the crank to a crosshead (M-050), which holds the blade lock bolt.

workingPrinciples.heading: 2. Reciprocating Physics
workingPrinciples.description: The machine operates by converting high-speed rotational energy from the motor into linear reciprocating motion of the blade through a slider-crank mechanism. The larger blade stroke in the KS-AUV ensures the blade exits the bottom of the stack to clear lint and ensure clean shears.

workingPrinciples.heading: 3. Automated Sharpening
workingPrinciples.description: Dual abrasive belts (M-189) move in opposing directions to maintain a constant edge angle on both sides of the blade simultaneously.

maintenance.definition: Blocked motor vents; running on LO speed too long (>30 min)
maintenance.action: Blow lint with air gun; restrict LO speed duration.

maintenance.definition: Lever E pressed too fast; motor shut off mid-cycle
maintenance.action: Lift Lever J to unlock; restart sharpening.

maintenance.definition: Worn abrasive belts; incorrect grit for material
maintenance.action: Replace belts (M-189); match grit to substrate.

maintenance.definition: Faulty Cut-out Switch or blown capacitor
maintenance.action: Inspect M-201 switch and M-206 capacitor.

maintenance.definition: Accumulation of lint/oil on base plate rollers
maintenance.action: Clean with solvent; DO NOT oil rollers.

finalNotes:
• Lubrication: Use only No. 30 motor oil or genuine KM oil. Never use thin sewing machine oil.
• Safety: Always ensure the blade guard is adjusted to the height of the fabric spread. For 3-phase units, check the arrow (C) for proper rotation direction.
• Speed Control: For dual-speed models, always start at HI speed before switching to LO to ensure sufficient initial torque.
